title: Tech Lead (Conversational Solutions)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.



Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.



Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.


  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Account Manager (Mandarin/Chinese Speaker)
description:

title: Gerente de ventas trilingue (Español, Inglés, Portugués)
description:
El supervisor de ventas (Gerente de Ventas) es responsable de supervisar la gestión de los equipos que dan soporte a las cuentas para impulsar la generación de ingresos y el crecimiento del negocio, liderar un equipo de ventas, ser responsable de impulsar el rendimiento del equipo a través de acciones de éxito del cliente (integración, adopción, verificaciones de integridad y voz del cliente) y/o acciones de retención de ingresos (renovaciones de contratos de productos/servicios, ampliación, ventas adicionales y expansión). Es responsable de gestionar, construir y desarrollar relaciones estratégicas con los clientes a través de un nivel equilibrado de implicación con el director de ventas y los clientes externos.


Objetivo del puesto:

Supervisar y orientar a un equipo de asociados de adquisición de clientes para alcanzar los objetivos de ventas de la empresa en el ámbito B2B de paises de LATAM (en español). Esto implica planificación estratégica, orientación y apoyo directo para garantizar el éxito del equipo.


Sus responsabilidades:

  • Dirigir, capacitar y orientar a un equipo de asociados enfocado en la adquisición de nuevos clientes empresariales en LATAM (paises que hablan español).
  • Desarrollar estrategias de adquisición integrales adaptadas al entorno empresarial brasileño.
  • Establecer relaciones sólidas con clientes y partes interesadas importantes.
  • Hacer un seguimiento y analizar las métricas de adquisición para perfeccionar las estrategias y mejorar los resultados.
  • Coordinar con equipos multifuncionales para garantizar una experiencia de integración perfecta para los nuevos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Más de tres años de experiencia demostrable en un puesto de ventas.
  • Es importante contar con más de 1 año de experiencia en liderazgo en un puesto similar en ventas.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de la dinámica del mercado de paises de LATAM (que hablan español), especialmente en el sector de las redes sociales y la tecnología.
  • Dominio del español y el inglés (B2+/C1), con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica

  • Auxílio-creche
  • Convênios e descontos comerciais
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber


Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.


SE#

  • Problem Solving: Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills with a methodical approach to problem resolution.
  • Communication & Documentation: Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to create comprehensive documentation.

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.


Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Fusões e Aquisições para fazer parte do nosso time!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Identificar, analisar e viabilizar oportunidades de M&A que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável e a diversificação do portfólio da companhia, contribuindo para sua consolidação como um player relevante na transição energética brasileira;
  • Análise de oportunidades, através de mapeamento de mercado, estudos setoriais, mapeamento de targets, interação com stakeholders externos ex: assessores financeiros sell-side/buy-side, análise de tendências e articulação interna com outras áreas, garantindo sinergias e aderência estratégica com o modelo de negócios da Copa Energia;
  • Desenvolver modelos econômico-financeiros para valuation de empresas, ativos e projetos greenfield e brownfield, conduzindo análises de sensibilidade, cenários e retorno sobre o investimento (TIR, VPL, Payback, etc), apoiando na construção de business cases com racional técnico e estratégico;
  • Responsável por preparar materiais para tomada de decisão executiva, criando apresentações com story telling, de acordo com o público, elaborando memorandos executivos, resumos estratégicos com recomendações e/ou pontos de atenção;
  • Apoiar a coordenação de processos de due diligence (financeira, legal, ambiental, técnica etc.), identificando riscos e pontos de atenção relevantes;
  • Conduzir a integração de empresas adquiridas (PMI), liderando planos de integração operacional e estratégico, alinhando processos, pessoas e sistemas;
  • Monitoramento de performance, priorização e governança do portfólio de iniciativas estratégicas em conjunto com áreas-chave;
  • Atuar em conformidade com os pilares ESG e de integridade.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • MBA, ou Especialização em Finanças Corporativas, M&A;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em Finanças corporativas e Valuation;
  • Processos de M&A;
  • Análise de mercado e estratégia.


Desejável:


  • Power BI
  • Macabacus
  • Think-cell


Tipo de contratação: Efetivo - CLT - Modelo Híbrido

Localidade: Morumbi – SP


Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição ou Restaurante na Unidade, conforme seu local de atuação e modalidade de contratação.
  • Vale Alimentação, que dá uma baita ajuda nas despesas de casa!
  • Vale Transporte.
  • Plano médico - para você cuidar da sua saúde e da sua família (dependentes diretos).
  • Plano odontológico - para você manter aquele sorrisão!
  • Gympass – para você cuidar da sua saúde física e ter muita energia!
  • Temos Crédito Consignado: parcelas descontadas direto na folha de pagamento e juros mais baixos.
  • Temos PR (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Temos Vale Gás mensal – uma exclusividade do nosso negócio;
  • Temos Cartão Farmácia;
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 (cento e oitenta dias) para você cuidar da pessoa mais importante da sua vida!
  • Auxílio Creche para as mamães por 24 meses, no retorno da licença maternidade;
  • Licença paternidade de até 20 (vinte dias) dias, conforme opção do colaborador. Afinal os papais também precisam curtir o momento;
  • Programa de Saúde e Bem-estar - Viva+Energia;
  • Subsídio estacionamento conforme seu cargo e local de trabalho (atrelado a elegibilidade do cargo);
  • Carro padrão aluguel conforme seu cargo (atrelado a elegibilidade do cargo);
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido na Sede da Copa Energia, para você tirar o que há de melhor dos dois modelos (presencial e home office);
  • New Value – Um Clube de Benefícios perfeito para garantir descontos ótimos em Beleza, Fitness, Comida, Cultura, Lazer e Turismo. Afinal uma forcinha no orçamento doméstico cai bem!
  • Seguro de vida, para dar aquela segurança!


A Copa Energia valoriza a vida por meio da segurança e do respeito com as pessoas e com o meio ambiente. Tratamos as pessoas como gostaríamos de ser tratados.


Acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para o nosso crescimento e da nossa sociedade como um todo. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas, independente da origem, gênero, cor, orientação sexual.

Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), alinhada ao nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a diversidade.


Venha energizar vidas com a gente!

title: Process Engineer - Liquids
description:
JOB SUMMARY

As part of the Process Engineering team you are responsible for the engineering process of refining, fat modification and oleochemical plants.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Design and calculate the refining, fat modification and/or oleochemical process of sold projects based on contractual and customer specifications, and on Desmet standards

and best practices.

  • Size and specify the required equipment.
  • Produce and compile related engineering documents (basic PFD, heat & mass balances,

utilities & consumptions, P&ID’s, operating manuals, description of automation, HAZOP

studies, …).

  • Perform plant start-up and commissioning activities and carry-out troubleshooting.
  • Gather and report site technical data and experience to improve our products and processes.
  • Improve existing processes and equipment.
  • Participate in and support R&D activities and projects: perform feasibility studies and

contribute to the development of new designs.

  • Give internal support and assist customers regarding health & safety issues, environmental

aspects, permits,…


REQUIRED PROFILE

Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical or Bio engineering).
  • 2-5 years of experience in an engineering department or company in process industry.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Special interest for processes and Unit Operations.
  • Pro-active and self-driven attitude, able to prioritize & meet deadlines.
  • Accurate and work organized.
  • Team player, sharing essential information.
  • Sufficiently analytical for trouble solving
  • Willingness to travel for short periods, representing our company.
  • English and/or Spanish preferred (strong asset), and any other language is an asset.


OUR OFFER


You will join a global market leader in an international environment with highly talented colleagues. We’ll offer you a fulltime position with an attractive compensation package with good benefits and the opportunity to grow and develop in your skills, competencies, and career.

Apply now with CV and short motivation:

title: Especialista I De Agilidade
description:
Descrição da vaga

Ser referência de conhecimento da metodologia ágil além de ser responsável por promover e disseminar a metodologia ágil, princípios, valores e práticas das squads visando maximizar a qualidade da entrega e impulsionando a excelência operacional das equipes ágeis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver Tribe Leads, Product Owners, People Leads e Dev Teams das squads através de capacitação formal e mentoria para que possam realizar as práticas ágeis;
  • Conhecer e zelar pelos processos padrões de trabalho, assegurando conformidade com certificações e políticas sejam elas internas ou externas, alinhadas com as definições da empresa e segmento, através de estudos e aplicações de práticas com as equipes;
  • Promover ações de melhoria contínua junto às squads com intuito de otimizar continuamente processos por meio de acompanhamentos conforme necessidade definida pelo time, participação em eventos ágeis e análise de indicadores de performance e de maturidade;
  • Realizar a troca de informações, experiências e conhecimentos com os outros agilistas através de reuniões de equipe com seus pares, observações em eventos ágeis e compartilhamento de conteúdos relevantes à sua atividade;
  • Realizar a gestão de projetos conforme a necessidade e estratégia da área e assegurar a entrega alinhado ao modelo ágil de trabalho e apresentando indicadores para a liderança da área, diretores e PMO corporativo;
  • Realização de apresentação de métricas e indicadores quando necessário para times, líderes e outros stakeholders;
  • Blindar o Dev Team de interrupções prejudiciais, removendo impedimentos e estimulando a análise da causa raiz, a fim de direcionar ações de melhoria;
  • Facilitar nos segmentos/squads sobre as melhores práticas ágeis, processos e ferramentas oficias como, JIRA, TDN, ZENDESK, Ferramentas Google, etc;
  • Compartilhar com os Gestores dos papeis ágeis feedbacks sobre o comportamento de qualquer integrante da equipe (sempre que necessário);
  • Participar da contratação de novos agilistas, através de processo seletivos internos e/ou externos;
  • Ser uma referência para os demais agilistas, dominando e multiplicando conhecimentos de agilidade, ferramentas e/ou processos e recepcionando os novos agilistas;
  • Compartilhar com todo o ecossistema TOTVS e comunidades externas conhecimentos e experiências para que promovamos o crescimento da agilidade e também para que ampliemos nossa própria percepção sobre as práticas ágeis;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em tecnologia e afins;
  • Vivência de 03 a 04 anos;
  • Vivência de 02 anos com liderança de equipes será um diferencial;
  • Principais práticas Lean Agile (exemplo: Scrum, Kanban, entre outros) – conhecimento aplicado;
  • Técnicas de facilitação;
  • Desejável: Design Thinking, Design Sprint, Lean Inception ou outros métodos equivalentes;
  • DevOps nível básico;
  • Métricas ágeis e OKR;
  • Gestão de Projetos;
  • Management 3.0.

Requisitos desejáveis

Certificações em agilidade (CSM, PSM, KMP, SAFe, ICP-ACC, entre outras).

Experiência em ambientes de transformação digital e cultural.

Vivência em acompanhamento de indicadores de maturidade ágil em larga escala.

Conhecimento em frameworks de escalabilidade (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify Model).

Experiência prática em ambientes de cloud e ferramentas de colaboração digital.

Atuação prévia em gestão de stakeholders e facilitação de rituais com nível executivo.

Vivência em análise de causa raiz e práticas de melhoria contínua (Kaizen, PDCA).

Conhecimento em práticas de Product Discovery e Product Management.

Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura, escrita e troca de experiências em comunidades globais.

Participação em comunidades ágeis (meetups, eventos, fóruns, grupos de estudo).

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos (DHO)
description:
Este é o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para silvicultura, gramado e jardim e construção. Como uma das start-ups mais antigas do mundo, estamos em uma jornada emocionante, trabalhando juntos em um ambiente global acelerado, onde nos desafiamos continuamente a continuar inovando e reinventando nossos negócios.

Com nossa paixão pela inovação, criamos produtos e serviços para clientes em todo o mundo. Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais e entendemos que nossas diferenças são nossos pontos fortes. Somos curiosos, ousados e construídos por nossas diferenças. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e candidatos. Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.


Hoje, o Grupo está com uma oportunidade que pode ser a sua cara, confira abaixo:


Resumo da Posição

O Analista de DHO atua como parceiro estratégico de negócio, suportando líderes intermediários e equipes em todos os temas relacionados a Pessoas & Organização. Sua missão é garantir que as práticas de gestão de pessoas estejam alinhadas à estratégia da companhia, promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento, desempenho e bem-estar dos colaboradores.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico da liderança, oferecendo consultoria em temas de gestão de pessoas, cultura organizacional e clima.
  • Apoiar os processos de ciclo de performance, calibração, promoções, sucessão e remuneração variável.
  • Conduzir e apoiar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de lideranças e equipes.
  • Colaborar com projetos de atração, retenção e engajamento de talentos.
  • Ser ponto de contato para temas relacionados a carreira, feedback, conflitos, reconhecimento e relações de trabalho.
  • Monitorar indicadores de P&O (turnover, engajamento, absenteísmo, diversidade e inclusão, etc.), propondo planos de ação.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Centros de Expertise (Remuneração, Talent Acquisition, D&I, Treinamento, etc.) para garantir a implementação local das iniciativas globais e regionais.
  • Apoiar mudanças organizacionais, garantindo comunicação clara e gestão de impacto junto às equipes.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia como Generalista de RH ou posições correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em processos de performance, sucessão, remuneração, desenvolvimento e engajamento.
  • Boa capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal, comunicação clara e influência.
  • Perfil analítico, com habilidade para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e indicadores de pessoas.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.
  • Espanhol intermediário (preferencial)


Competências Comportamentais

  • Orientação para resultado e foco no cliente interno.
  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução prática.
  • Capacidade de construir relações de confiança e atuar como conselheiro dos gestores.
  • Resiliência, adaptabilidade e postura colaborativa.
  • Mentalidade inclusiva e aberta à diversidade.

title: Analista de Planejamento de Exportação Pleno
description:
RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO:


Localização: Sede Nestlé (São Paulo – SP)

Reporte: Gerente de Exportação


Propósito da posição:

Entrar na Nestlé significa que você está se juntando à maior empresa de alimentos e bebidas do mundo. Em nosso núcleo, temos um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, com pessoas apaixonadas, movidas pelo propósito de melhorar a qualidade de vida e contribuir para um futuro mais saudável. E procuram a cada dia mais crescer juntas, ter espírito de dono e trabalhar com excelência.


Como Analista de Abastecimento de Exportação você será responsável pelo planejamento dos abastecimentos e gerenciamento das coberturas dos estoques de produtos terminados e semielaborados para afiliadas Nestlé ao redor do mundo, gerando valor para negócios de 1 categorias estratégicas, produzidas em 1 fábricas e exportadas desde 3 centros de distribuição para 57 países.


O dia a dia...

  • Analisar semanalmente os requerimentos dos volumes de exportação de produtos terminados e semielaborados, conforme as políticas de estoque acordadas com os Mercados Importadores;
  • Alinhar semanalmente, com o time de Demand/Supply Planning e Fábricas, as necessidades de produção para os volumes de exportação;
  • Criar as ordens de carregamentos de exportação para logística internacional;
  • Gerenciar os KPIs de planejamento como: Customer Order Fulfillment; Freshness; Stock Cover e Forecast Accuracy;
  • Participar de forma ativa e efetiva de reuniões semanais e mensais com os Mercados Importadores, bem como Programação de Produção, Equipe de Planejamento de demanda e as Unidades de negócios, seguindo o ciclo semanal de planejamento e buscando garantir níveis de estoque saudáveis.


O que vai contribuir para o seu sucesso?

title: Dealer Development Specialist
description:
We are hiring for one of our clients a leading manufacturer of bikes, Qutes ＆ electric 3-wheeler


Job Title: Dealer Development Manager

Base Location: Sao Paulo


Experience Requirement : 5 years of relevant experience in Dealer Development, Network Expansion, and Automotive Retail Operations with exposure to dealer audits, process improvement, and profitability management.


Role Type: Individual Contributor


Role Purpose: To drive dealer network effectiveness, profitability, and readiness by ensuring process excellence, systems standardization, and continuous capability enhancement across all dealerships. The role will be pivotal in shaping the of dealer network, ensuring strong process discipline and sustainable business growth.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Dealer Network Development & Performance

· Drive network planning and coverage expansion, ensuring strategic presence across markets to maximize business potential.

· Design and implement workshops aligned with corporate identity (CI) norms, optimizing dealer infrastructure and service readiness.

· Conduct periodic dealer performance reviews to assess business health, profitability, and customer experience outcomes.

· Identify underperforming dealerships, recommend improvement plans, and oversee implementation through cross-functional collaboration.

· Strengthen dealer capability through structured engagement, capability-building, and performance enhancement programs.

· Partner with field teams to ensure uniform brand experience across all customer touchpoints such as sales and aftersales.

2. Systems, Processes & Operational Excellence

· Establish and standardize systems, processes, and review mechanisms across all dealerships and regions to ensure consistent operations and governance.

· Implement and monitor business analytics and intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making and profitability tracking at dealerships.

· Lead process improvement and re-engineering initiatives to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and dealer–customer experience.

· Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) from within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.

· Audit dealerships to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain performance and compliance.

· Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.


Key Interfaces:

Internal Stakeholders:

· Field Sales Teams

· Service Teams

· Finance

· Legal

External Stakeholders:

· Dealership Owners and Management Teams


Impact & Contribution:

· Direct impact on dealer profitability, customer experience, and market performance.

· Strengthens network capability by ensuring standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.

· Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

title: Senior HRBP LATAM

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model

title: FBS Sr Product Designer
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


About the Role

Farmers hiring a Senior User Experience (UX) Designer to join the Farmers Customer Experience Team, a multidisciplinary group that combines the power of human-centered and data-driven approaches to create end-to-end omni-channel experiences that enhance customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and deliver business impact.

This role drives strategic design by deeply understanding current user experiences, identifying opportunities, and envisioning future-state solutions. It leads the creation of effective user experiences through advanced UX principles and strategic thinking while independently delivering design solutions, collaborating with stakeholders, and contributing to evolving design systems.

The ideal candidate would have already achieved a senior level of UX and digital product design proficiency (including the associated tools, collaboration skills, and understanding of technology) and is now looking to grow by applying that experience strategically within the broader context of Customer Experience and Service Design.


Key Responsabilities


  • Plans and facilitates workshops and design sprints to establish alignment, understand business objectives, develop concepts, and chart strategic paths forward.
  • Contributes to user research efforts interviews, surveys, usability testing, A/B tests, and competitive evaluations to uncover behaviors, motivations, and pain points. Collaborates with Journey Owners and research teams to define target audiences and goals.
  • Maps user journeys, workflows, and service touchpoints to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Applies insights to recommend UX improvements, validate decisions, and develop design concepts that balance user needs with business objectives.
  • Creates wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to explore, communicate, and document solutions.
  • Tests and refines layouts, user interfaces, interaction patterns, and system components to ensure consistency and quality. Develops clear documentation and specifications to enable seamless implementation and guide development processes. Supports the evolution of design systems by evaluating and updating components to promote scalability and reusability.
  • Collaborates with product teams, development teams, and stakeholders to define requirements and co-create solutions. Participates in planning sessions and design reviews to facilitate implementation of features and functionality as designed.
  • Keeps stakeholders informed on goals, expectations, and timelines throughout the design process. Leads meetings effectively and presents with polish, using advanced storytelling and presentation skills to convey context, design concepts and rationale through a compelling narrative.
  • Conducts post-launch design evaluations to assess effectiveness of the design work, identify usability issues, recommend refinements, and measure impact.
  • Accepts and incorporates feedback to improve performance and work quality while knowing when to change direction or stay the course.
  • Seeks out opportunities to advance design skills by staying informed on trends, tools, and best practices in user experience. Actively explores and appropriately integrates AI tools into the design workflow.
  • Mentors less experienced team members to develop skills while providing feedback they seek and value.

Requirements

  • Minimum three years of experience required in user experience (UX) design, product design, or related field.
  • Bachelors degree preferred
  • Tools: Figma, Mural/Miro, Rally/Jira, Office Suite
  • Deep understanding of UX principles, usability, and product design.
  • Familiarity with customer journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to present ideas clearly and confidently.
  • Effective collaboration and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Excellent time management and project prioritization skills.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and product management practices.
  • Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Mural/Miro, and Microsoft Office.
  • Basic knowledge of front-end development concepts.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation capabilities.

Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health Insurance
  7. Pension Plan

title: Senior Manager, Engineering Ops (Devops)
description:
Title : Senior Manager, Engineering Operations

Level : Manager or Senior Manager

Location : Brazil

Work setup : Remote (within 1hr from São Paulo, Brazil) *Eventually will be hybrid, 2-3 days in

office once we open an office next year

Department : Engineering


Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Head of Engineering, Engineering Operations to lead our

engineering operations which includes areas such DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE),

CI/CD, Release management etc for our cloud-based systems and applications. This role is

pivotal in ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and availability of our systems while driving

innovation in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and operational efficiency. You will be responsible for

crisis management, improving system performance, cost and fostering a culture of operational

excellence.


Responsibilities

● Leadership and strategy

○ Lead and mentor teams in DevOps, SRE, and Engineering Operations, fostering

a culture of collaboration, ownership, and innovation.○ Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for engineering operations, aligning

with business goals and product requirements.

○ Advocate for and implement industry best practices in system reliability, DevOps,

and automation.

● Reliability and availability

○ Drive initiatives to improve the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud-

based applications and infrastructure.

○ Establish performance measurements for various system health metrics.

○ Ensure robust incident management and crisis response processes to minimize

downtime and customer impact.

● DevOps and CI/CD

○ Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines to

enable seamless and automated deployment processes.

○ Leverage automation tools and practices to reduce manual interventions and

improve operational efficiency.

○ Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enable rapid and reliable

feature delivery.

● Monitoring and observability

○ Implement and maintain advanced monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to

gain deep insights into system health and performance.

○ Use observability tools (e.g., Grafana) to proactively identify and resolve issues

before they impact customers.

● Crisis and Incident Management

○ Lead crisis management efforts during high-severity incidents, ensuring quick

resolution and effective communication with stakeholders.

○ Conduct root cause analyses and drive post-mortem reviews to identify and

address operational gaps.

● Team Development and Collaboration

○ Build, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering operations team with

expertise in DevOps and SRE practices across multiple geolocations.

○ Foster close collaboration with development, data, and product teams to align

engineering operations with overall business objectives.

○ Promote a blameless post-mortem culture to encourage continuous learning and

improvement.

● Cost Optimization and Security

○ Optimize cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining system reliability and

scalability.

○ Implement robust security practices in operations to ensure compliance with

industry standards and regulations.


Qualifications

● 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years in leadership roles

● Proven track record of improving system reliability, availability, and performance for

cloud-based applications.

● Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

● Demonstrated expertise in crisis management and incident response in high-pressure

environments.

● Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS) and container orchestration tools

(Kubernetes, Docker).

● Strong proficiency in monitoring and observability tools like Grafana.

● Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

● Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence

stakeholders across engineering and business teams.

● Proven ability to lead and grow high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

● A strong focus on fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and operational

excellence.

● Influence partner engineering teams like platform and product engineering.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with contact center technologies and software to manage operations effectively.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities to address issues quickly and efficiently.


Work Environment:

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

Para maiores informações acesse


Na SYSTRA, além de contribuir com conhecimento e ideias inovadoras, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time de referência global, conectado por um propósito comum: transformar a mobilidade com excelência, audácia e colaboração. Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.


A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.

description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes



Descrição:

Buscamos um profissional para coordenar a infraestrutura de redes em nossa organização. O Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes será responsável pelo planejamento, implementação, manutenção e monitoramento das redes corporativas, garantindo segurança, performance e alta disponibilidade. Este profissional atuará diretamente com a equipe técnica e com outros departamentos, assegurando a continuidade dos serviços e a conformidade com as políticas internas e externas.

Vivência:

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Head of FP&A
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented Head of FP&A to join us in Sao Paulo! The Director will serve as a key strategic partner to the Senior Leadership Team in Latin America, leading the overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis functions for the organization in Brazil. The Director will report to the VP of FP&A - Americas located in the United States.

This leadership role is responsible for translating business strategy into financial plans, providing data-driven insights to support critical decision-making, and driving operational efficiency and financial performance improvements. The Director will also be responsible for managing, mentoring, and developing a highly performing FP&A team.


Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Direct the preparation of timely, accurate, and insightful management reports (e.g., Monthly/Quarterly Business Review packages) for the Senior Leadership Team in LatAm
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis on financial performance (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast/Prior Year), identifying key trends, opportunities, and risks, and clearly articulating the 'story behind the numbers.'
  • Own and manage the reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring metrics are relevant and drive accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting and Controllership teams to ensure accurate financial data consolidation and reporting in compliance with local BR GAAP and international standards (e.g., IFRS/US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Prepare compelling financial presentations and reports for executive leadership, and other stakeholders


Strategic Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting:

  • Lead the comprehensive annual planning (Budget) and long-range planning (LRP) processes for Latin America, primarily in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic goals.
  • Manage the quarterly financial forecasting process, incorporating business drivers, market trends, and operational changes to ensure high accuracy and predictability.
  • Develop complex financial models (e.g., scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis) to evaluate new business initiatives, and strategic projects.


Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary finance partner to the General Manager - LatAm and other functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, Operations), providing financial advice and challenging assumptions.
  • Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive management.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost management and resource allocation, recommending actions to optimize profitability and operational efficiency.


Team Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, mentor, and motivate a team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, analytical rigor, and professional growth.
  • Define team goals, allocate resources efficiently, and manage workflows to ensure all deliverables are met accurately and on time.
  • Lead efforts to streamline and automate FP&A processes and systems to improve efficiency and data integrity.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA degree highly desirable.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), public accounting, investment banking, or private equity; with a strong focus on operational expenses, and preferably with a large multinational corporation.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of financial professionals.
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting software (Anaplan, AARO), ERP systems, CRM systems (Salesforce), and Visual Reporting (Tableau) highly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear and concise insights for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in finance within a technology or telecommunications environment would be advantageous
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required for effective communication with international leadership.
  • Fluency in Spanish desirable but not required.

title: Professor
description:
IMK, escola de educação infantil bilíngue localizada no Alto de Pinheiros em São Paulo, procura professora Montessori para sala de 3-6 (Primary)


Responsabilidades:


Gestão do Ambiente Preparado:

  • Preparar e manter meticulosamente um ambiente de aprendizagem Montessori que seja seguro, acessível, organizado, limpo e esteticamente agradável.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais pedagógicos estejam completos, em perfeito estado de conservação e dispostos de forma lógica e atraente.
  • Realizar a rotação de materiais conforme a observação das necessidades e interesses do grupo.
  • Criar uma atmosfera de calma, ordem e respeito mútuo na sala.

Observação e Planejamento Pedagógico:

  • Observar ativamente as crianças em seu trabalho, registrando seu progresso, interesses, desafios e desenvolvimento social, emocional e acadêmico.
  • Utilizar as observações diárias para planejar lições individualizadas e em pequenos grupos, respeitando o ritmo único de cada criança.
  • Manter registros detalhados e precisos do desenvolvimento de cada aluno para acompanhar seu progresso e compartilhar com os pais e a coordenação.

Apresentação de Lições e Orientação (O Papel de "Guia"):

  • Apresentar os materiais e conceitos Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) de forma clara, precisa e cativante.
  • Atuar como "Guia", conectando a criança ao material e protegendo seu ciclo de trabalho e concentração, intervindo o mínimo necessário.
  • Estimular a independência, a autodisciplina, a resolução de problemas e o pensamento crítico.
  • Não corrigir o erro da criança diretamente, mas sim guiá-la para que ela mesma o perceba e aprenda com ele.

Desenvolvimento Social e Emocional:

  • Fomentar um ambiente de comunidade e colaboração entre as crianças de idades mistas.
  • Modelar e ensinar ativamente "Graça e Cortesia", orientando as crianças na resolução de conflitos, comunicação respeitosa e habilidades sociais.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da autoestima, confiança e empatia de cada criança.

Comunicação e Colaboração:

  • Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação regular, transparente e positiva com os pais/responsáveis, compartilhando o progresso da criança e fortalecendo a parceria escola-família.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de pais e conferências individuais.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a assistente de sala, coordenação pedagógica e demais membros da equipe escolar.
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe, eventos escolares e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.


Requisitos e Qualificações

Formação Essencial:

  • Formação Superior: Graduação completa em Pedagogia ou áreas afins (Psicologia, Letras) com a devida complementação pedagógica.
  • Certificação Montessori: Formação (Curso de Especialização) no Método Montessori específica para a faixa etária de 3 a 6 anos (Casa dei Bambini), emitida por uma instituição reconhecida (como AMI, AMS, OMB ou equivalentes).
  • Fluência ou nível avançado em Inglês (para escolas bilíngues).

Experiência Exigida:

  • Experiência prévia comprovada atuando no Método Montessori em um ambiente de 3 a 6 anos.
  • Vivência prática na apresentação de todo o currículo Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) para esta faixa etária.

Habilidades e Competências:

  • Profundo Conhecimento: Compreensão sólida da filosofia Montessori e das teorias de desenvolvimento infantil.
  • Capacidade de Observação: Habilidade aguçada para observar a criança de forma científica e neutra, identificando suas necessidades e interesses.
  • Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e respeitosa com crianças, pais e colegas de equipe.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Postura calma, paciente, empática e resiliente, sabendo manejar os desafios da sala de aula com equilíbrio.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Forte senso de organização para a manutenção do ambiente e para o planejamento pedagógico individualizado.
  • Proatividade: Capacidade de agir como um(a) facilitador(a) dinâmico(a), em vez de um(a) instrutor(a) diretivo(a).
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar efetivamente com a assistente de sala e demais membros da escola.

Diferenciais (Desejável, mas não obrigatório):

  • Habilidades em artes, música ou movimento.
  • Experiência com crianças com necessidades educacionais especiais (inclusão).
  • Conhecimento em Comunicação Não-Violenta (CNV) ou Disciplina Positiva.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Analista de Processos Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


●Diagnóstico e Mapeamento (As-Is): Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e sessões de observação com stakeholders para um levantamento detalhado dos processos atuais.

●Análise Crítica: Analisar os processos mapeados para identificar gargalos, restrições, dependências, ineficiências, redundâncias, retrabalho e pontos de falha que impactam a performance e a qualidade.

●Investigação de Causa Raiz: Aplicar técnicas estruturadas (como Diagrama de Ishikawa, 5 Porquês) para diagnosticar a origem dos problemas identificados, indo além dos sintomas.

●Desenho e Modelagem (To-Be): Projetar processos futuros, otimizados e alinhados às melhores práticas, utilizando notações padrão de mercado (ex: BPMN) para garantir clareza e consistência.

●Definição e Validação: Definir o escopo, os objetivos e as métricas de sucesso para iniciativas de melhoria, validando as soluções propostas com as áreas de negócio e garantindo o alinhamento estratégico.

●Documentação e Gestão do Conhecimento: Criar e manter a documentação técnica dos processos, incluindo fluxogramas, manuais, e regras de negócio, servindo como uma base de conhecimento para a organização.


Competências Técnicas :


●Domínio de BPM: Sólida experiência com as práticas e disciplinas do BPM (Business Process Management), tendo como referência o guia BPM CBOK.

●Técnicas de Levantamento: Proficiência em conduzir entrevistas, observar operações e facilitar workshops para coletar requisitos e mapear processos de forma precisa.

O Consultor de Suprimentos é responsável por liderar estrategicamente a gestão de uma ou mais categorias de compras, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa e o cumprimento das políticas internas.   • Atuar como ponto focal para temas relacionados à sua categoria, representando a área em fóruns técnicos e reuniões multidisciplinares.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário da área, definindo premissas de custo e realizando análises gerenciais.
  • Liderar iniciativas de otimização de processos, buscando eficiência operacional e automação via sistemas ERP.
  • Suportar auditorias internas e externas, bem como interações com áreas jurídicas, financeiras e de compliance.
  • Zelar pelo alinhamento às políticas corporativas de ética, sustentabilidade, segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade.

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions


This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support


This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events


What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Operation Strategy
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategy Formulation: Based on the characteristics of SMB and SAKA business structures, clarify strategies around different dimensions such as merchant basic information, review, and menus; identify key indicators, key initiatives, and implementation paths to ensure strategy feasibility.
  2. Strategy Implementation: Transform strategies into practical approaches suitable for frontline teams, rationally break down objectives, assign them to specific individuals and actions; coordinate resources to resolve key bottlenecks, ensuring strategies truly drive team members to achieve business goals. Coordinate and resolve cross-departmental collaboration and execution obstacles to ensure efficient implementation and a closed-loop process at each key stage.
  3. Strategy Evaluation and Iteration: Evaluate strategy effectiveness through data review and performance evaluation; propose adjustments to inefficient processes, forming a closed-loop strategy iteration system to continuously optimize city-level business.
  4. Resource and Tool Development: Develop SOPs for the entire business process. Create exclusive sales scripts, brand service reports, and case studies for chain merchants, forming replicable and efficient signing and closing strategies.
  5. Performance Scheme Development: Utilize data as a management tool to participate in the development of performance evaluation schemes for each module. Performance and incentives: Address sales momentum. Based on the goals at different stages, design new contract performance and incentive programs to stimulate sales momentum and drive efficient achievement of targets.


Job Requirements

  1. Education Background: Bachelor's degree or above.
  2. Work Experience: (Hard Requirements) At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the internet industry; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with sales processes and rhythms, experience in strategy development and incentive mechanism design; experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry is preferred.
  3. Skills and Analytical Abilities: Possess clear logical thinking ability; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with SQL and common business analysis methods, strong data sensitivity, and ability to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  4. Project Management Ability: Ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion.
  5. Collaboration Ability: Ability to efficiently coordinate internal and external teams, drive the execution of complex projects, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
  6. Language Requirements: (Hard Requirements) English CET-6 or above. A strong command of English is a plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Analista de gerenciamento de dados
description:
